segments.text: This episode follows the entire family trying to get on a plane to Hawaii for Jay’s birthday. They haven’t even left Los Angeles yet, and the vacation is already falling apart.

segments.text: Gloria has planned the whole trip as a surprise. Jay thinks she’s taking him to Maui for a romantic week alone. Then Claire, Phil, Mitchell, Cameron, all the kids, and Lily show up with luggage. Gloria has bought tickets for everybody.

segments.text: Jay tries very hard to look happy. What he actually wanted was a quiet week by the pool with Gloria and a stack of novels. Instead, Cameron has planned activities, Manny wants to explore the island, and the family is preparing some kind of birthday performance.

segments.text: Mitchell handles most of the packing and then realizes at the airport that he left his wallet at home. Without his ID, he can’t fly.

segments.text: The trip home is a mess. Phil and Mitchell miss turns, get locked out of the house, climb through a window, and set off the alarm. They finally get the wallet and race back to the airport.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Claire gets more nervous about the flight and starts drinking to calm herself down. Manny is stopped by security because another Manny Delgado is on a no-fly list, and Gloria’s angry attempt to defend him only makes the situation more intense.

segments.text: Jay admits he’s nervous about flying too. He says he has a lot more to lose now than he used to. But what’s really bothering him is that Gloria seems to have planned an entire family vacation without any time for the two of them.

segments.text: Then security notices that Jay and Manny have different return dates. That gives away Gloria’s final surprise: the rest of the family is flying home after six days, while Jay and Gloria are staying longer by themselves.
